thread:
Maya: Quick sync — just finished FinPlate onboarding call, capturing their feedback here so we can triage and slot into roadmap. Short list: 1) they want a sandbox/testing workspace for their QA team, 2) per-customer cost visibility (granular breakdown for long history), 3) embeddings latency spikes for large-batch uploads.
Jamal: solid, can you paste the verbatim asks? helps for prioritization and PRD notes.
Maya: pasted highlights below from their screenshots and call notes:
- "Need a reproducible sandbox that mirrors prod limits but with safe data redaction."
- "Cost reports today are too coarse — show hourly + per-route + per-model for at least 90 days."
- "When we do 50k-100k embedding rows, the embeddings route sometimes takes >800ms per request and times out in our pipeline."
Eli: embeddings latency — do we know if it's one specific model or across multiple? also, any logs/trace ids?
Maya: they used text-embedding-compact-v2 and a custom batching script. I asked for trace ids and sample payload. Shared screenshot of their pipeline run (will DM the file).
Sophia: From an enablement angle, sandbox + redaction is a common ask. We have the internal checklist for sandbox setup, can we turn that into a one-click CS enable flow?
Jamal: proposing a quick triage rubric: impact (customer size & renewal stage) x frequency (how often customers ask) x engineering effort. FinPlate is mid-market, up for renewal in 6 months — so medium-high impact.
Eli: for the embeddings spike, immediate mitigation could be: reduce batch size by 30% + enable KV cache for repeats. I can ship a small doc with config suggestions and a diagnostic script to measure per-batch latency.
Maya: that would be helpful. I'll offer the config script as an interim workaround. Customer asked to keep this low-friction — prefer config changes over code changes.
Sophia: I'll draft a short enablement playbook: how to set up ephemeral sandbox (steps + redaction checklist) and how to run the diagnostic script.
Jamal: can we get a rough effort estimate? Eli, two numbers: quick mitigation doc (low effort), sandbox-first-pass (med effort), full per-customer billing export UI (high).
Eli: quick doc + diagnostic script ~2 dev-days. Sandbox-first-pass (internal automation for CS) ~1 sprint (3 dev-days + infra). Billing export UI depends on analytics infra — need a discovery ticket, estimate 2-3 sprints.
Maya: tagging this for roadmap intake. Action items: 1) Eli — diagnostic script & config doc (ETA Fri), 2) Sophia — enablement playbook (ETA Mon), 3) Maya — collect traces + customer consent to test in sandbox (today). Jamal — please add prioritization score to intake board.
ops-bot: Reminder: please fill out the CS intake form for new product requests: https://redwood.internal/cs-intake. Forms speed up triage and ensure required fields (customer size, renewal window, impact).
Jamal: thanks — added preliminary priority to the intake board. Maya, drop the trace artifacts in the thread when you have them.
Maya: will do. If anyone wants to join a short triage huddle tomorrow, ping me — otherwise I'll move this into CS backlog and flag for the next product planning sync. :thumbsup:
